questions.question: The tribes of Israel demanded that Benjamin hand over the wicked men of Gibeah, and Benjamin agreed. True or false?
After Israel lost two battles to the tribe of Benjamin, the LORD told them to fight again. What did He promise?

answers.text: He would deliver Benjamin into their hand the next day
Judah would win the battle alone
Benjamin would give up within seven days

questions.question: In Israel's third battle against the tribe of Benjamin at Gibeah, who does the text say defeated Benjamin?
During Israel's battle against Benjamin at Gibeah, a signal went up and the Benjamites looked behind them. What did they see?

answers.text: Their own men coming to help
